content: In a note MK says Qāsim-i Anvār, before becoming Niʿmat Allāh's khalīfa, was a disciple of Ṣadr al-Dīn Ṣafavī (d. 794/1391), but that, against Savory's picture of him as an active Safavid propagandist, there is no evidence he kept his link to the Ardabil shrine after his master's death (Binbaş).
refers_to_primary: Binbaş, 'The Anatomy of an Attempted Regicide'; Savory (via MK fn 90)
